shots.motion: A young nurse steps out of glowing hospital doors into heavy rain, lowers her wrist after checking her watch and starts walking, rain falling, red sign glowing
A young woman runs down wet station stairs toward the camera, braid swinging, tote bag bouncing, rain dripping
A local train approaches through heavy rain with its headlight blooming, slowing to a stop at the platform, rain streaks lit by the headlight
A tired young nurse sitting in a swaying night train, head resting on the window, eyes slowly closing, city lights streaking past outside, tube light flickering
An old man sitting on a train seat looks up and smiles gently, blinks slowly, the train sways softly, warm light on him, city lights streaking past
A young woman leans her head on the train window, blinks slowly, colored city lights sweep across her face, rain drops on the glass
An old man leans forward and holds out an old ticket toward the young woman, speaking kindly, the train sways
A young woman takes a ticket from an old hand, looks down at it with a puzzled polite smile, the train sways
A trembling hand holds an old burnt train ticket, light flickers across it, slow push in
A young woman looks up from the ticket and starts to speak with an amused half laugh, the train sways, lights pass outside
An empty green train seat, rain streams down the window behind it, fluorescent light flickers, city lights streak past, eerie
A young woman stands in the empty train aisle and turns her head left and right anxiously, grab handles swing, the train sways
A ticket checker punches the young woman’s pass while she points at an empty seat in alarm, the train sways
A ticket checker frowns and glances around the empty train coach, uneasy, flickering light above
A trembling hand holds an old ticket, the wristwatch second hand stops, slow push in, dark train background
